cues: In the backward direction, hydronium gives a proton back to acetate.

text: But the reaction is reversible. In the backward direction, hydronium gives a proton back to acetate. So there are two acids and two bases. Acetic acid and acetate differ by exactly one proton: they are a conjugate acid base pair. Water and hydronium are the other pair.
